data.body:
[P2] Allow retirement to complete provisional invocation intervals

The base evidence contract permits a narrower fixture-observed interval until the native completion record becomes available. After an early failure, retirement can therefore legitimately extend `endedAtMs` or establish an earlier `startedAtMs`. Requiring exact equality rejects that completed snapshot and quarantines a successfully retired target, causing queued cases to fail. Keep invocation identities immutable, but allow the final interval to contain the original interval while retaining the original-activity settlement checks. Add a regression for provisional observations followed by complete native invocation evidence.
